scientific_integrity: The geometric characteristic-p Poncelet porism is attributed to the primary literature. The new arithmetic graph, splitting, orbit, and rational polygon counts are proved directly. Independent mathematical review has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only ordered smooth conic pairs of geometric intersection type (4) in odd characteristic.
Counts simple base-field rational polygons up to rotations and reversal, not all geometric Poncelet cycles.
A historical equivalent in other finite-geometry terminology cannot be excluded.
Standalone finite-field checks support but do not replace the general symbolic proof.
title: Arithmetic splitting of fourfold-contact Poncelet conics
